title: Understanding the Bootstrap Table
text: The table shows bootstrap replicates and their summary statistics. Each row represents a bootstrap sample, and the columns show the values drawn in each sample. The row means, variances, and medians are calculated for each sample.

title: Identifying the Right Endpoint
text: To find the right endpoint of the 50% confidence interval for the population variance, look at the row variances (rowvars) and identify the value that corresponds to the 75th percentile.

title: Calculating the 75th Percentile
text: The row variances are $$985$$, $$243$$, $$290$$, and $$918$$. Arrange these values in ascending order and find the 75th percentile.
